issue_text: click.prompt and click.confirm ignore an empty prompt_suffix. Supplying prompt_suffix='' still renders a suffix instead of no suffix.
A boolean flag option configured with an environment variable yields True even when the variable indicates a false value. The bug involves default, flag_value, and type handling.
An Option using show_default as a custom string does not display that string in an interactive prompt, although it appears in help output.
Choice shell autocomplete returns the wrong value for enum choices; the completion result cannot be passed back as the chosen enum.
Fish shell completion breaks when a completion item's help text spans multiple lines. The generated completion value is malformed.
